name: Nevada
gaps: The governmental services tax uses the original MSRP; without it the engine uses the price, which understates the tax on a used car.
The age used in the depreciation schedule is counted as the calendar year minus the model year (at least one year once the car has been registered); the DMV computes it from its own records.
DMV pages disagree on the price of standard plates ($3.50 on the FAQ page, $10 plate recovery plus a $1 prison fee on the replacement page), so plates are shown as a range.
Emissions test prices are set by each station in the Las Vegas and Reno urban areas; the line has no amount, and remote parts of Clark and Washoe counties are exempt.
The DMV fee estimator could not be used to cross-check (it requires a VIN and a captcha).
No dealer documentation fee cap was read on an official Nevada page for this release; Nevada taxes that fee.

summary.docFeeNote: No cap read on an official Nevada page for this release; the fee is subject to sales tax.
summary.inspectionWhere: Yearly emissions test for gasoline cars based in the urban areas of Clark and Washoe counties from the fourth registration of a new car (hybrids from their sixth model year); electric cars are exempt.

singular: Nevada's yearly governmental services tax is 4 cents per dollar of a valuation equal to 35% of the original MSRP, whatever price you paid [regfees].
That valuation depreciates by law to 95% after one year, 85% after two and 55% after five, and stops at 15% from nine years [nrs-371].
Clark and Churchill counties add a voter-approved supplemental governmental services tax of 1 cent per dollar of the same valuation for road projects [regfees].
The minimum governmental services tax is $16 a year, so even an old car pays it [nrs-371].
A passenger car pays a flat $33 registration fee whatever its weight [regfees].
Sales tax runs from 6.85% in the smallest rural counties to 8.375% in Clark County and 8.265% in Washoe County [county-rates].
Private party sales, family sales and gifts are not subject to sales tax; the tax applies to dealer sales on the actual purchase price [regfees].
A trade-in lowers the taxable price, and a dealer's document fee is subject to sales tax [automotive].
New cars skip the emissions test for their first three registrations and hybrids for five model years [emission].
